regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, metadata, and two-column introduction
regions.finding: Verified the article title/DOI and classified the abstract as an aggregate current-method claim. The Introduction contains prior Pd/Ir allenylic-substitution and kinetic-resolution context; external cited work was not promoted to current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Supporting Information availability statement
regions.finding: The publisher states that online Supporting Information exists, but source mapping marks association unestablished; no SI procedure, substrate identity, or result was inferred.

unresolved: Page 1 contains no experiment-specific arrow/table or complete operation.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 1a/b
regions.finding: Separated the cited prior Ir/L1 reaction and proposed key intermediate from the current generic monodentate-ligand kinetic-resolution class; neither was assigned a concrete scope yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 2 and time-course plot
regions.finding: Recorded the concrete L2 preliminary reaction: 1a/2a each 0.5 mmol, Ir 2.5 mol%, L2 10 mol%, acid 0.75 equiv, m-xylene 0.1 M, sieves, 0 °C/8 h, 3a 39%/87% ee, recovered 1a 57%/84% ee, s=38. The qualitative time-course trend was retained without estimating graph points.

regions.region: page 2 lower/right Scheme 3 narrative
regions.finding: Classified the S1→S2 and S2→S3/L3–L10 generic ligand-synthesis arrows separately from the concrete BF3·OEt2 branch to S3' (81%, >20:1 dr, 99% ee).

unresolved: Most ligand-synthesis operational details and individual yields are absent from the main text.
The Scheme 2 graph does not tabulate individual time-point values.

regions.region: page 3 full-width Scheme 3 structures and arrows
regions.finding: Inspected the generic arylation/spirocyclization/phosphoramidite-installation route, S3' 81% branch, ligand structures L3–L10, and CCDC labels. Generic Ar/R variants remain general schemes rather than fabricated unique runs.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left/right Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: Mapped L1/L1', acid omission/replacements, Sc(OTf)3, sieve omission, -10 °C, alternative-metal, and low-loading conclusions to their row-specific records. Footnote alternatives are split because they are separate tests, not mixtures.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 4 scope discussion and limitations
regions.finding: Linked successful substrate/nucleophile classes to the page-5 scope rows. Recorded the explicitly stated CN-substrate and substituted-allene no-reaction classes without importing SI identities.

unresolved: Unsuccessful-example structures referred to SI are not associated and remain label-only.
Several compact ligand/substrate structures remain unverified candidates with null SMILES.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 1 header, entries 1–11, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Recorded every distinct condition, expanding entry-5 Lewis acids and entry-10 metal catalysts into alternative-specific records. Product/recovery/conversion/trace/major-product outcomes and measurement bases are preserved. The arrow/footnote factor-of-ten charge discrepancies are retained in every applicable record.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left scope text and Equation 1
regions.finding: Recorded the standard-condition failure of alkyl substrate 1x separately from the Ho(OTf)3/CyMe/40 °C/20 h success giving 3x in 80% yield and 66% ee.

regions.region: page 4 upper/right indole limitation text and Equation 2
regions.finding: Recorded four standard-condition indole no-reaction tests as identity-limited rows and the separate La(OTf)3/THF/r.t./36 h 1g+N-methylindole success giving 3y in 61% yield and 72% ee. The text-reported racemic recovered substrate is not relabeled as product yield.

regions.region: page 4 right-column scale-up, transformations, and control-experiment narrative
regions.finding: Linked the 3 mmol scale-up, four Scheme 5 transformations, and four Scheme 6 control arrows to their page-5/6 records without duplicating narrative mentions.

unresolved: Table 1 prints conflicting arrow/footnote acid, catalyst, and ligand quantities; all are retained without correction.
Several failure screens do not restate substrate identity, charge, recovery, or detection limit.
Equation 1/2 recovered-substrate amounts and analytical bases are unreported.

regions.region: page 5 upper Scheme 4 reaction header, 22 product/recovered-substrate pairs, caption and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all 22 displayed scope arrows independently with shared charges/conditions, conversion, selectivity factor, product isolated yield/ee, and recovered-starting-material yield/ee. For 3g, 21% isolated and parenthetical 41% crude NMR yields are both retained. The 2.5 mol% versus 0.125 mmol Ir discrepancy is explicit.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left Scheme 5a scale-up
regions.finding: Recorded the distinct 3.0 mmol 1a/1.5 mmol 2a, 30 h standard-condition run: 51% conversion, s=211, 3a 41%/93% ee, recovered 1a 45%/99% ee.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left Scheme 5b transformations
regions.finding: Recorded four independent transformations. The Cu/B2Pin2 then NaBO3 sequence is two ordered stages and its 67% is an overall two-step yield, not a last-step yield.

regions.region: page 5 lower-right kinetics and Ir/L3 complex prose
regions.finding: Linked first-/zero-order conclusions to three page-6 kinetic series. Recorded the stable isolated (L3)3IrCl complex attempt and its separate catalytic-inactivity arrow.

unresolved: Scheme 4 catalyst amount/loading conflict is unresolved by design.
Scheme 5 transformations omit most reagent quantities and operating/workup details.
The (L3)3IrCl isolation procedure and yield are not reported.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left Scheme 6a no-nucleophile arrow
regions.finding: Recorded enantiopure (R)-1a (99% ee) under standard conditions for 30 h with no nucleophile: >90% recovered at 96% ee.

regions.region: page 6 upper/middle-left Scheme 6b three control arrows
regions.finding: Recorded matched (R)-1a/L3, mismatched (S)-1a/L3, and (R)-1a/rac-L3 experiments separately with their 8/8/5 h times, product yields or trace, recovered-substrate yields, ee values, and unresolved trace-product configuration.

regions.region: page 6 upper-right Scheme 6c kinetic plots
regions.finding: Recorded three separate concentration-variation series: first order in [Ir/L3] and zero order in 1a and 2a, retaining displayed fits and catalyst-series R² without estimating graph coordinates.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left Scheme 7 complex structure and inactivity arrow
regions.finding: Recorded (L3)3IrCl isolation/structure characterization separately from its standard-condition catalytic test, where 3a was not observed.

regions.region: page 6 DFT Studies text
regions.finding: Classified the 1b/2a DFT model, trans/cis eta2 complexes, geometries, relative energy, and acid-promoted carbocation pathway as a computed mechanism, not experimental preparations. Later-page energy profiles are outside this coverage claim.

unresolved: Kinetic operating conditions/point tables are not printed in the covered panels.
The trace mismatched product has undetermined absolute configuration and no numerical yield.
DFT details referred to unassociated SI and later pages were not imported.
